composing_text: The infantry regiments of the division then on the island or landing this day (Miller, chapter IX).
source_locator: R2225: ch. IX; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
notes: Miller, ch. IX, and Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9: on 4 January 1943 2nd Marine Division headquarters and the 6th Marines, Reinforced, landed from New Zealand. De Carre acted as division commander; Marston remained in New Zealand because he was senior to Patch. Confidence 0.7.

source_locator: R2225: ch. XI, The Coastal Offensive
current_activity: opening its first operation as a complete division, on the Point Cruz-Hill 66 line
notes: Miller, ch. XI: on 12 January 1943 the 2nd Marine Division received orders from Patch to advance west from the Hill 66-Point Cruz line. The attack of 13 January, supported by Americal and 2nd Marine Division artillery and the 2nd Marine Air Wing, was the division's first operation as a complete division. The 2nd and 8th Marines attacked that morning and the 6th Marines moved up at noon. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.

location_qualifier: coastal front west of Point Cruz
source_locator: R2225: ch. XIV, The CAM Division
current_activity: opening the CAM Division's full-scale attack toward Kokumbona
notes: Miller, ch. XIV: on 22 January 1943 the CAM Division - the 2nd Marine Division with the 6th Marines and the attached 182nd and 147th Infantry - opened a full-scale attack as part of the XIV Corps offensive. Units from all three infantry regiments participated. The division advanced about 1,000 yards but was still some 1,000 yards east of Hills 98 and 99. The CAM Division is a composite force, not a separate unit id; this claim is on 2nd Marine Division headquarters. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.

source_locator: R2225: ch. XV, Final Operations on Guadalcanal
current_activity: attacking as the CAM Division and advancing about 1,000 yards beyond the Poha
notes: Miller, ch. XV: the CAM Division attacked on 26 January 1943 and advanced 1,000 yards beyond the Poha, with little fighting. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
